name: Blade Ball Practice
desc:
👍 Like the game for UPDATES and make sure to join the community server below to talk with the devs and see sneak peeks!

☄️ The original Blade Ball "Practice" (BBP) game and our own take on the game genre! You can instantly respawn without having to wait for the match to end OR practice the game solo!

⚔️ Time your guard perfectly to deflect the homing ball to someone else.

🤖 Make a private server to practice one on one against an NPC.

🎮 Controls:
- BLOCK: Left Click / F / Button / R1
- ABILITY: Right Click + Shift Lock / Q / Button / ButtonX
- SHIFTLOCK: Shift / Button / ButtonY

Founder: Staticaliza (PROXDGAMER00)
Owner: Zaixoz

DISCLAIMER: This game uses its OWN assets and didn't steal from Blade Ball, the idea of Blade Ball itself is taken from minigames in other games such as TF2 and Overwatch.
